facts.fact: The Reserve Bank of Malawi granted PayChangu Limited a Payment Service Provider licence (PSP-003/26) for payment aggregation, per Malawi24.

systems.platform: payment aggregation of mobile money, card and bank transfers

MWI.note: Document states nothing on consumer protection rules or redress.
Document states nothing on cross-border payments.
Document states nothing on government payments to people.

facts.fact: The Reserve Bank of Malawi issued licence PSP-003/26 under the Payment Systems Act, 2016, per Malawi24.
Under the Payment Systems Act, 2016 the Reserve Bank of Malawi licensed local fintech PayChangu Limited as a payment service provider, per Malawi24.

MWI.note: Document gives no survey figure on account holding.
Licence permits aggregation but document does not say a service is in service.
Document states nothing on tax or fee payment.
Document states nothing on startup law or funding.
